mapper.sql: t.id, t.confirm_id, t.car_id, t.car_no, t.car_type, t.car_vehicle, t.org_id, t.user_ids, t.user_names, t.amount, t.back_col1, t.back_col2, t.remark, t.status, t.sort, t.eps_id, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.tenant_id
mapper.select: select ,d.dept_name orgName from car_aduit_free t left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = t.org_id and d.del_flag = '0' where t.id = #{id}

select sum(ifnull(a.dif_amount, 0)) escapedAmount,count(distinct a.car_no) number from car_except_record a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime1},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.create_time < date_add(STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime2},'%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day)

select sum(ifnull(amount, 0)) amount, count(distinct car_no) carNum, d.dept_name orgName, a.org_id from ( select t.car_no,t.amount,t.org_id,t.create_time,t.del_flag,t.status from car_confim_free t where t.del_flag = '0' UNION all select t.car_no,t.amount,t.org_id,t.create_time,t.del_flag,t.status from car_aduit_free t where t.del_flag = '0') a left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = a.org_id and d.del_flag = '0' where a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '0'
and a.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.create_time < LAST_DAY(#{startDate}) and d.tree_leavel = 2 and d.tree_leavel = 3 and a.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime1},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.create_time < date_add(STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime2},'%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day) group by a.org_id order by amount desc

select count(1) confirmCount from car_confim_free a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime1},'%Y-%m-%d') and a.create_time < date_add(STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime2},'%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day)

select sum(t.amount) amount, count(distinct t.car_id) carNum, t.org_id, d.dept_name orgName from (select ifnull(a.amount, 0) amount, a.car_id, a.org_id from car_aduit_free a where a.del_flag = '0' UNION all select ifnull(c.amount, 0) amount, c.org_id, c.car_id from car_confim_free c where c.del_flag = '0') t inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = t.org_id and d.del_flag = '0' and t.org_id = #{orgId} and d.dept_name like concat('%',#{orgName},'%') and t.create_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime1},'%Y-%m-%d') and t.create_time < date_add(STR_TO_DATE(#{applyTime2},'%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day) group by t.org_id order by amount desc
mapper.update: update car_aduit_free set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
